citation.title: Effect of scanning strategies on the accuracy of digital intraoral scanners: a meta-analysis of in vitro studies
citation.authors: Hardan L, Bourgi R, Lukomska-Szymanska M, Hernández-Cabanillas JC, Zamarripa-Calderón JE, Jorquera G, Ghishan S, Cuevas-Suárez CE

s_design.anchor: SR/meta-analysis of diagnostic accuracy studies (in vitro IOS trueness/precision)

domains.evidence_quote: The protocol and important documents regarding to this review were recorded at Open Science Framework (https://osf.io/gf7b4/).
The following databases were investigated: Embase, Scielo, PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science.
Among these, 37 studies were excluded for the following reasons: (23) did not include comparisons between different scanning techniques
domains.note: PRISMA flow reports screening counts plus numbered reasons for full-text exclusions; v2.4 low tier — shared reason per category with individually cited studies

domains.domain: risk of bias assessment of included studies
domains.evidence_quote: The risk of bias (RoB) of the manuscripts included in this review was independently assessed by two participants of the review (LH and RB) according to the evaluation of the following parameters: specimen randomization, single operator, control group, operator blinded, standardized specimens, and sample size calculation.
domains.note: Independent dual assessment with a custom six-parameter checklist, not an established diagnostic-accuracy RoB tool such as QUADAS-2

domains.evidence_quote: A random-effect model was used for the analyses, and pooled-effect estimates were obtained by comparing the standardized mean difference of the trueness and precision

domains.note: No funnel plot, Egger's test, or publication-bias wording in Methods, Results, or Discussion of the full text

penalties.item: no conflict-of-interest statement anywhere in the text at all, or funding by a commercial manufacturer whose own product is among those tested
penalties.note: Full text on jap.or.kr carries no conflict-of-interest or funding disclosure section

penalties.item: clinical trial not prospectively registered (RCTs only)
no sample size justification / power analysis (clinical studies); for in-vitro, specimen count per group <10 with no justification
penalties.note: not applicable to a secondary study

penalties.item: follow-up shorter than the outcome plausibly requires (e.g. survival claims with <3y follow-up)
penalties.note: not applicable — diagnostic accuracy in vitro, not a survival outcome

sources.fact_fa: امتیاز شواهد این منبع ۴۷ از ۱۰۰ و باند C است؛ نوع سؤال Diagnostic است.
sources.interpretation_fa: این متاآنالیز پانزده مطالعهٔ آزمایشگاهی را با پروتکل ثبت‌شده در OSF و جست‌وجوی پنج دیتابیس جمع کرده و خشک بودن سطح و لندمارک مصنوعی را به‌عنوان بهبوددهندهٔ دقت نشان می‌دهد، اما ارزیابی publication bias در متن نیامده، RoB مطالعات واردشده با چک‌لیست اختصاصی (نه QUADAS-2) انجام شده، و اعلان تعارض منافع/حمایت مالی در متن کامل دیده نشد. یافته‌ها in vitro‌اند و چکیده دربارهٔ الگوی S شکل با Results ناسازگار است — برای استناد به Results تکیه کنید.
